title: Concept: Rollbar access token in a response
description: A Rollbar access token inside client configuration in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The token lets anyone post items to the project's item feed, so an attacker can flood the queue or hide a genuine crash report among synthetic ones.
applicability: Deployments that render a Rollbar access token inside client configuration into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The token lets anyone post items to the project's item feed, so an attacker can flood the queue or hide a genuine crash report among synthetic ones.
